name: cafe
mood: Tidewater Café, a lakeside neighbourhood café at golden morning light. Warm honey oak, polished brass, white Carrara marble, mustard and sage velvet, terracotta and glossy green plants. Cozy, precious, a little old-world European.

items.prompt: A classic bentwood café chair in warm honey oak: a curved hoop backrest with a second inner hoop, a round woven cane seat, four slightly splayed legs joined by a bentwood ring.
The SAME bentwood café chair in warm honey oak (curved double-hoop backrest, round woven cane seat, splayed legs with a ring).

A round bistro table: white Carrara marble top with fine grey veins and a thin polished brass edge band, a single fluted brass pedestal on a round stepped brass foot. The round top reads as an ellipse exactly twice as wide as it is tall.
A plush mustard-yellow velvet club armchair with rolled arms, deep button tufting on the curved back, a thick seat cushion with piping, short turned walnut legs.
The SAME mustard-yellow velvet club armchair (rolled arms, curved tufted back, piping, turned walnut legs).
A tall brass floor lamp: a round weighted brass base, a slim polished pole with a small knuckle joint, a softly curved neck and a pleated cream silk shade glowing warmly from inside.

sheets.name: chair-back
sheets.note: The second reference image shows this exact chair from the front. Draw the SAME chair turned around so we look at it from directly BEHIND: the outside of the curved double-hoop backrest is nearest to us, in front, covering most of the round cane seat, which is only glimpsed behind it. Same wood, same proportions, same pixel style.

items.prompt: The bentwood café chair from the reference, in warm honey oak, seen from behind.
A deep sage-green velvet Chesterfield sofa for two: rolled arms, button-tufted back, two plump seat cushions with piping, short turned walnut legs.
The SAME sage-green velvet Chesterfield two-seater sofa (rolled arms, tufted back, turned walnut legs).
A low rectangular walnut coffee table with rounded corners and tapered legs; on top a small brass tray with two white cups of cappuccino, a folded newspaper and a little vase with one yellow flower.
A lush monstera plant with big glossy split leaves in a round terracotta pot with a lighter rim; two leaves spill over the rim.
A tall fiddle-leaf fig tree with large violin-shaped glossy leaves on a slim trunk, in a tall glazed deep-teal ceramic pot with a gloss highlight.
A round bar stool: oak seat with a brass footring and three slim black-iron legs.

A café chalkboard menu, very slightly wider than tall (about 1.1 : 1), in a thick carved honey-oak frame with small brass corner caps. On the dark green-black slate: a hand-drawn chalk border of little vines, a steaming coffee cup and a croissant doodle at the top, then four neat lines of chalk 'handwriting' as abstract squiggles (NOT real letters), with tiny price-like dots on the right, one line in warm yellow chalk. Soft chalk dust smudges.

A small oil painting in portrait orientation (about 2 : 3) in an ornate gilded frame with bright gold glints: a calm lake at morning with a pine-covered far shore, a tiny red rowing boat, soft pink-and-gold clouds reflected in the water.

sheets.name: counter
sheets.note: All six objects belong to one matching café set. The counter segments are MODULAR: exactly one floor tile long, designed to sit in a row of identical segments, so their left and right ends are plain straight cuts of the same panelling and marble (no end caps, no rounded ends).

items.prompt: ONE modular segment of a café bar counter, exactly one floor tile long and one tile deep: a front of vertical honey-oak tongue-and-groove panelling with a slim brass kick rail near the floor, a thick white Carrara marble countertop with a rounded front edge. Nothing on top.

The SAME modular café counter segment seen from the barista's side: the back of the honey-oak counter with an open shelf holding stacked white cups and two small drawers with brass pulls, under the same white marble top. Nothing on top.

A compact, gleaming two-group espresso machine in chrome and polished brass with a domed brass top where little white cups are warming, two portafilters with wooden handles, a steam wand and a round pressure gauge. Its front (portafilters) faces along the red arrow.
The SAME chrome-and-brass espresso machine seen from behind: its polished back panel with a small brass maker's plate (no text), the domed brass top with little cups, the tip of a steam wand.

A small curved-glass pastry display case with a brass frame and base: two croissants, a lemon tart with a mint leaf and three pink macarons on two little shelves. The curved glass front faces along the red arrow.
The SAME curved-glass pastry case seen from the back (the server's side): a flat glass back with a little brass sliding door, the pastries seen through the glass.

sheets.name: countertop
sheets.note: Small objects that stand ON a café counter; same set, same materials.

items.prompt: An antique brass cash register with ornate scrollwork, round typewriter-style keys and a small drawer; its keys face along the red arrow. No text or numbers.
The SAME antique brass cash register seen from behind: the smooth ornate brass back, the top of the display flag.
A neat little stack of white porcelain coffee cups on saucers next to a small tower of three saucers, with a silver milk jug.
A tall glass apothecary jar with a round brass lid, full of golden biscotti.
A white porcelain cake stand under a glass dome, holding a pink layer cake with one slice cut out.
A small glass tip jar with a few coins and a folded note, and a tiny potted succulent beside it.
